senses.definition: present participle and gerund of sue
The act of one who sues for something.

quotes.text: […] her husband's increased and more frequent storms of passion, unfollowed by any halcyon and honeymoon suings for forgiveness […]
quotes.reference: 1834, Edward Bulwer-Lytton, The Pilgrims of the Rhine:

senses.definition: (obsolete) The process of soaking through anything.

quotes.text: In this instance, there is, upon the by, to be noted, the percolation or suing of the verjuice through the wood; for verjuice of itself would never have passed through the wood: so as, it seemeth, it must be first in a kind of vapour, before it pass.
